actions.description: Append values to the end of a spreadsheet table
actions.name: append-values-to-spreadsheet

spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update. Example: "1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms"

range.description: The A1 notation of a range to search for a logical table of data. Example: "Sheet1!A1" or "Sheet1"

values.description: The values to append to the spreadsheet. Each inner array represents a row of data.

valueInputOption.description: How the input data should be interpreted. "RAW": The values will be parsed as if the user typed them into the UI. "USER_ENTERED": The values will be parsed as if the user typed them into the UI, but formulas will be calculated.

insertDataOption.description: How the input data should be inserted. "OVERWRITE": Overwrite existing data. "INSERT_ROWS": Insert new rows.

majorDimension.description: The major dimension of the values. "ROWS": Values are organized by row. "COLUMNS": Values are organized by column.

actions.description: Clear values from ranges matching data filters, preserving formatting
actions.name: batch-clear-values-by-data-filter

spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update. Example: "1abc123xyz"

sheetId.description: The ID of the sheet. Example: 0

startRowIndex.description: The start row (inclusive). Optional for unbounded.

endRowIndex.description: The end row (exclusive). Optional for unbounded.

startColumnIndex.description: The start column (inclusive). Optional for unbounded.

endColumnIndex.description: The end column (exclusive). Optional for unbounded.

dataFilters.description: The data filters used to determine which ranges to clear

spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet

clearedRanges.description: The ranges that were cleared, in A1 notation

spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet

clearedRanges.description: The ranges that were cleared, in A1 notation

developerMetadataLookup.description: Selects data associated with the developer metadata matching the criteria

dataFilters.description: The data filters used to match the ranges of values to retrieve

actions.description: Apply multiple updates to a spreadsheet in a single request
actions.name: batch-update-spreadsheet

actions.description: Clear values from a range, preserving formatting
actions.name: clear-values

spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update. Example: "1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j"

range.description: The A1 notation or R1C1 notation of the values to clear. Example: "Sheet1!A1:D10"

actions.description: Copy a sheet to another spreadsheet
actions.name: copy-sheet

sourceSpreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet containing the sheet to copy. Example: "1aBcD..."

sheetId.description: The ID of the sheet to copy. Example: 123456789

destinationSpreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to copy the sheet to. Example: "2xYzA..."

sheetId.description: The ID of the newly copied sheet

title.description: The title of the newly copied sheet

index.description: The zero-based index of the sheet within the spreadsheet

sheetType.description: The type of sheet (GRID, OBJECT, etc.)

rowCount.description: The number of rows in the grid, if applicable

columnCount.description: The number of columns in the grid, if applicable

actions.description: Insert a new column into a sheet
actions.name: create-column

spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet. Example: "1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms"

sheetId.description: The sheet ID (0-based). Defaults to 0 if not provided. Example: 0

columnIndex.description: The zero-based column index where the new column will be inserted. Example: 2 to insert at column C

inheritFromBefore.description: If true, the new column inherits formatting from the previous column. If false or not set, inherits from the next column.

actions.description: Insert a new row at a given index in a Google Sheet
actions.name: create-spreadsheet-row

spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet. Example: "1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms"

sheetId.description: The ID of the sheet (can be found via the API). Example: 687284948

sheetName.description: The name of the sheet for A1 notation. Example: "Sheet1"

rowIndex.description: The index where to insert the row (0-based, where 0 is the first row). Example: 5

values.description: Array of values to insert in the new row. Example: ["John", "Doe", "john@example.com"]

sheets.description: Array of sheets to create in the spreadsheet

spreadsheetId.description: The unique ID of the created spreadsheet

spreadsheetUrl.description: The URL to view the spreadsheet in Google Sheets

actions.description: Delete a worksheet by name from a Google Spreadsheet
actions.name: delete-worksheet

spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the Google Spreadsheet. Example: "1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms"

worksheetName.description: The name of the worksheet to delete. Example: "Sheet2"

actions.description: Get spreadsheet data matching data filters
actions.name: get-spreadsheet-by-data-filter

spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to retrieve. Example: "1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j"

developerMetadataLookup.description: Selects data associated with developer metadata

a1Range.description: Selects data matching A1 range notation (e.g., "Sheet1!A1:C10")

items.description: Filter to select which ranges to retrieve from the spreadsheet

dataFilters.description: The data filters used to select which ranges to retrieve from the spreadsheet

includeGridData.description: True if grid data should be returned. Ignored if a field mask is set in the request

excludeTablesInBandedRanges.description: True if tables should be excluded in the banded ranges

ActionOutput_google_sheet_getspreadsheet.description: Spreadsheet object with data matching the specified filters

actions.description: Get values from a spreadsheet range
actions.name: get-values

spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to retrieve data from. Example: "1aBcD..."

range.description: The A1 notation or R1C1 notation of the range to retrieve values from. Example: "Sheet1!A1:C10" or "Sheet1"

values.description: The data values in the range, as a 2D array where each inner array represents a row

actions.description: Update or move a conditional format rule
actions.name: update-conditional-format-rule

spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update. Example: "1aBcD..."

sheetId.description: The ID of the sheet to apply the rule to. If not specified, applies to all sheets.

index.description: The zero-based index of the rule to update or move.

newIndex.description: The zero-based new index to move the rule to. Use this to reorder rules.

rule.description: The new conditional format rule. If provided, replaces the existing rule. If omitted, only moves the rule.

ranges.description: The ranges to apply the conditional format to.

booleanRule.description: A boolean rule - formats cells based on true/false condition.

gradientRule.description: A gradient rule - formats cells with color gradients.

actions.description: Update values in a spreadsheet range
actions.name: update-values

spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update. Example: "1abc123def456ghi"

range.description: The A1 notation of the values to update. Example: "Sheet1!A1:B2"

values.description: The data to write, as an array of arrays. Each inner array represents a row. Example: [["A1", "B1"], ["A2", "B2"]]

valueInputOption.description: How the input data should be interpreted. RAW = values as-is, USER_ENTERED = parsed as if typed into the UI. Default: USER_ENTERED

majorDimension.description: The major dimension of the values. ROWS = each inner array is a row, COLUMNS = each inner array is a column. Default: ROWS

includeValuesInResponse.description: If true, the response includes the updated cell values. Default: false

actions.description: Append or update a row of values in a Google Sheet
actions.name: upsert-row

spreadsheetId.description: The ID of the spreadsheet to update. Example: "1aBcD..."

range.description: The A1 notation of the range to search for existing data and append to. Example: "Sheet1!A1:E" or "Sheet1"

values.description: The row values to upsert. Example: ["Name", "Email", "Phone"]

keyColumn.description: The column index (0-based) to use as the key for matching existing rows. If not provided, always appends.

keyValue.description: The value to match in the key column for updating an existing row. Required if key_column is provided.

syncs.description: Sync worksheet rows from a Google Sheet
syncs.name: rows

spreadsheetId.description: Google Spreadsheet ID. Example: "1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms"

sheetName.description: Sheet/worksheet name. Defaults to first sheet if not provided. Example: "Sheet1"

range.description: Cell range to sync. Defaults to entire sheet if not provided. Example: "A1:Z1000"

syncs.description: Sync worksheets from a Google Sheets spreadsheet
syncs.name: worksheets

spreadsheetId.description: ID of the parent spreadsheet

index.description: Zero-based index of the worksheet within the spreadsheet

sheetType.description: Type of the sheet (GRID, OBJECT, etc.)

rowCount.description: Number of rows in the grid (for GRID sheets)

columnCount.description: Number of columns in the grid (for GRID sheets)

spreadsheetId.description: Google Sheets spreadsheet ID to sync worksheets from
